x: 1 mile: 1 Saunders (T.); 2 Main (B.); 3 Scott (B. & P.); 4 Chudd (G.).
With half a mile to go he was a good 20yds clear, but the fireworks were by no means over, for Saunders of T.V.H. put in a desperate effort to close the gap on the tiring figure ahead.

New blood is continueing to flow into our membership and there is a good chance that McGrath and Saunders (both Juniors) and Morrison (just a Senior) will blend with our more established walkers and play a leading part in Belgrave's resurgence.
Also recommended with a good chance of making the top 12. Saunders Shiraz 88. A newcomer who has outclassed several established names.
